 document outlines the inspection checklist I2 , to be performed

The first draft initiated by eng Gamal Sayed 
 Soliman tested at 16 Sep 02, at Assuit 500 ME,

items: A work order must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Main air tank must be isolated.
Check the values of pressure gauges.

text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
 document outlines the inspection checklist I2 , to be performed 
 on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng Gamal Sayed 
 Soliman tested at 16 Sep 02, at Assuit 500 ME,
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Air compressor must be isolated.
Main air tank must be isolated.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Work
to be Carried Out
Check the values of pressure gauges.
Drain the main air tank
Check the frequancy of the automatic operation of the air compressor unit 
 by checking the air leakage.
Check the oil level of the compressor.
Check the indication of compressor's first stage pressure gauge.
Calibbration of the pressure gauge.
Check the performance of pressure switchs and safety valves.
Draining of pipe line.

بدأ المسودة الأولى المهندس Gamal Sayed Soliman، واختُبرت في 16 سبتمبر 2002 في Assuit 500 ME،

items: يجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
افحص تكرار التشغيل التلقائي لوحدة ضاغط الهواء بفحص تسرب الهواء.
افحص قراءة مقياس ضغط المرحلة الأولى للضاغط.
افحص أداء مفاتيح الضغط وصمامات الأمان.
